evidence.title: Teaching LLMs How ICU Physicians Approach Clinical Reasoning Through OMOP-Aligned Retrieval Improves Reasoning Across Clinical Domains

summary: A new study demonstrates that aligning large language models with OMOP-based retrieval improves their clinical reasoning abilities across ICU and other medical domains. The approach mimics how physicians process patient data, leading to more accurate and context-aware AI assistance.
title: OMOP-Aligned Retrieval Enhances LLM Clinical Reasoning for ICU Physicians
